resources.string: No sign-in. Writes steps, distance, and exercise to Health Connect with non-overlapping time windows.
Health Connect is not available on this device.
Install or update Health Connect, then reopen QFit.
Wrote %1$d segment(s): %2$d steps, %3$.0f m. Open Health Connect to verify.
Tip: tap Write 1 segment twice quickly — totals should add (376), not merge. Then check distance / exercise in HC and your downstream app.
QFit writes walking steps, distance, and exercise sessions on this phone so other health apps can read them. It does not sign you in or send your Google account to the developer.
